crossRefs.note: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.
Absalom did this sort of thing to all Israel who came to the king for judgment. So Absalom stole the hearts of the men…
Behold, all the men of Israel came to the king, and said to the king, “Why have our brothers the men of Judah stolen…
Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.
My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious;

The children of Israel fled before Judah, and God delivered them into their hand.
Abijah and his people killed them with a great slaughter, so five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell down slain.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The people of Israel were struck there before David’s servants, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.
translations.bsb: There the people of Israel were defeated by David’s servants, and the slaughter was great that day—twenty thousand men.
translations.kjv: Where the people of Israel were slain before the servants of David, and there was there a great slaughter that day of twenty thousand men.
translations.asv: And the people of Israel were smitten there before the servants of David, and there was a great slaughter there that day of twenty thousand men.
